description: This file manages authentication profile usage, including cooldowns, failure handling, and cooldown state updates, with functions for marking success/failure, cooldowns, and cooldown resets, as well as probe logic for external rate limit checks.

methods.name: isAuthCooldownBypassedForProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider bypasses auth cooldowns based on normalized provider ID.

methods.name: shouldProbeWhamForFailure
methods.description: Determines if a failure reason for a provider warrants probing the external rate limit API.

methods.name: resolveWhamResetMs
methods.description: Resolves the reset time in milliseconds from a WhamUsageWindow object.

methods.name: isWhamWindowExhausted
methods.description: Checks if a WhamUsageWindow indicates exhaustion (used percent >= 100).

methods.name: applyWhamCooldownResult
methods.description: Applies the cooldown result from a Wham probe to existing profile usage stats.

methods.name: probeWhamForCooldown
methods.description: Probes the external API to determine if a profile should be in cooldown based on rate limits.

methods.name: resolveProfileUnusableUntil
methods.description: Calculates the timestamp until which a profile is unusable based on cooldown and disabled times.

methods.name: isProfileInCooldown
methods.description: Checks if a profile is currently in cooldown, considering provider bypass and profile stats.

methods.name: resolveProfilesUnavailableReason
methods.description: Infers the most likely reason all candidate profiles are unavailable based on their cooldowns and failure reasons.

methods.name: getSoonestCooldownExpiry
methods.description: Returns the earliest timestamp when profiles become usable again among a set of profiles.

methods.name: shouldBypassModelScopedCooldown
methods.description: Determines if cooldowns should be bypassed based on model scope and current cooldown state.

methods.name: clearExpiredCooldowns
methods.description: Removes expired cooldowns and resets error counters for profiles in the store.

methods.name: markAuthProfileUsed
methods.description: Marks a profile as successfully used, updating lastUsed and resetting error counters.

methods.name: calculateAuthProfileCooldownMs
methods.description: Calculates cooldown duration based on error count, with stepped backoff times.

methods.name: resolveAuthCooldownConfig
methods.description: Resolves the cooldown configuration for a provider, considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: calculateDisabledLaneBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates backoff time for disabled failure reasons based on error count.

methods.name: resolveDisabledFailureBackoffMs
methods.description: Resolves backoff time for specific disabled failure reasons.

methods.name: resolveProfileUnusableUntilForDisplay
methods.description: Returns the timestamp until which a profile is unusable, for display purposes.

methods.name: resetUsageStats
methods.description: Resets usage stats to initial state, optionally overriding fields.

methods.name: updateUsageStatsEntry
methods.description: Updates a profile's usage stats in the store with a provided updater function.

methods.name: keepActiveWindowOrRecompute
methods.description: Keeps the existing cooldown window if active, otherwise uses a recomputed value.

methods.name: computeNextProfileUsageStats
methods.description: Computes the next usage stats for a profile after a failure, considering cooldowns and failure reasons.

methods.name: markAuthProfileFailure
methods.description: Marks a profile as failed for a reason, updating cooldowns and failure counts, with optional external probe.

methods.name: markAuthProfileCooldown
methods.description: Marks a profile as transiently failed with stepped backoff times.

methods.name: clearAuthProfileCooldown
methods.description: Manually clears cooldowns for a profile, resetting error counters.
